text:
IncidentBot: paging: Alert - runtime-serving p95 latency spike (service: runtime-prod) after staged rollout 2026-03-15T14:20Z. Auto-notify to #incidents and oncall.
DeployBot: deploy event v3.2.1 -> started at 2026-03-15T14:15Z, cohort: 10% traffic, step=stage-2
Jordan: seeing the alert, checking graphs now. p95 up ~600ms from baseline, throughput down ~30% on a subset of hosts.
Sam: logs show a lot of "kernel_fallback: true" entries on the g4x hosts, repeated KV cache miss churn.
Jordan: putting grep output here for context:
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:10Z] runtime: kernel_select: fallback to generic_kernel, reason=unsupported_fp
[2026-03-15T14:22:11Z] kvcache: miss_rate=0.28, eviction_rate=0.12
[2026-03-15T14:22:12Z] serve: token_latency_ms=42, p95_ms=1123
```
Aisha (oncall): is this only on the staged cohort or global?
Jordan: looks mostly on eu-west-1 and a few us-west-2 nodes that got the new runtime binary. Non-staged nodes stable.
Priya: could be a kernel selection regression in the new binary interacting with quantized models. Any recent kernel selector changes?
Sam: yes, v3.2.1 included a change to prefer a new fused-attn kernel when seq_len < 1024; fallback path wasn't exercised in canary tests for long-context workloads.
Marta (support): I'm getting inbound tickets about slow completions from 6 enterprise tenants, some are timing out in our UI.
Aisha (oncall): customer-impact: 6 tenants, partial outages for interactive gen endpoints, severity S2 (possible S1 if escalates). Notify CSMs and support.
Jordan: quick mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to disable new kernel preference, 2) rollback the deploy, 3) apply hotfix to kernel selector. Flipping flag is fastest.
Sam: agree. Feature flag name is runtime.kernel_preference_v2, default=true. Setting to false forces previous kernel selection.
Aisha (oncall): who can flip now? I can run the toggle, but need someone to monitor immediate effects.
Jordan: I'll watch live metrics. Aisha, go ahead.
Aisha (oncall): running toggle now:
```
curl -XPOST https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"flag":"runtime.kernel_preference_v2","value":false}'
```
DeployBot: flag change accepted, propagation started.
IncidentBot: Event: flag.runtime.kernel_preference_v2 -> false (by Aisha).
Jordan: graphs showing p95 dropping on affected hosts, partial recovery within 45s. Throughput climbing back to baseline.
Sam: logs: kernel_fallback entries disappearing, kvcache miss_rate falling to 0.05.
Marta (support): confirmed with two tenants that UI responsiveness returned, closing their urgent tickets.
Aisha (oncall): good short-term fix. We still need root cause and a follow-up plan: revert the kernel selector change in master and add longer-context canary tests.
Priya: I'll take the postmortem. Actions: 1) rollback kernel selector patch in source and open PR with extra unit+integration tests, 2) add seq_len stress to canary harness, 3) run a targeted test across quantized models across regions.
Jordan: timeline: I'll prepare the revert PR now and mark as hotfix. Sam will validate on a staging cluster.
Sam: starting validation run against staging with extended sequences.
DeployBot: note: deploy v3.2.1 still at 10% traffic. Recommend pausing further rollout.
Aisha (oncall): paused. Do not progress cohort.
Priya: I'll coordinate customer comms. Marta, please prepare an incident banner for affected tenants with ETA for full mitigation.
Marta (support): on it, drafting banner: "We're aware of reduced performance for some completions in EU/US regions after a recent rollout. We have applied a flag-based mitigation and are monitoring. No data loss. Engineering will follow up with root cause."
Jordan: quick checklist for handoff to next oncall (Priya):
- current state: feature flag off, metrics stable for 10m, 6 tenants affected with impact resolved
- mitigations: flag flipped, rollout paused
- next steps: PR revert + extended canary, schedule controlled rollout after tests
- known risk: if we re-enable flag without extra tests, regression recurs on long-context quantized models
Aisha (oncall): handing off to Priya for the midnight shift. Priya, please acknowledge and pick up the follow-ups.
Priya: ack, taking handoff. I'll own the postmortem and coordinate the revert PR and canary test additions.
IncidentBot: Handoff note recorded: from Aisha to Priya at 2026-03-15T15:02Z.
Marta (support): CSMs notified, banner live.
Priya: I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Jordan and Sam in 30 minutes to review PR and canary test plan. Any other asks?
Jordan: capture the kernel selection logs and add them to the incident ticket. I'll attach debug traces.
Sam: once PR is merged, let's run a small canary in eu-west-1 only, then expand. No global rollout until +48h observation.
Aisha (oncall): thanks all. I'll stay available for questions during the handoff window.
Priya: thanks — I'll close this incident thread once the revert PR lands and canary completes successfully.
IncidentBot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.
